A 2024 recommender study validates metamorphic testing across LibRec, PREA and Surprise: input/output relations expose reliability faults without exact recommendation oracles. Its evidence concerns classical libraries, so BERT4Rec-specific relations need separate validation. A 2025 study combines metamorphic relations with mutation testing to assess detection strength and input sensitivity—supporting controlled fault injection before trusting diagnostic probes. [Recommender study](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.infsof.2024.107410), [mutation assessment](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.infsof.2025.107807).

For BERT4Rec, documented semantics are bidirectional attention with padding excluded and inference from an appended MASK token. Suggested fixtures: verify masked targets cannot leak through training inputs; final nonpadding readout handles unequal left-padded lengths; batch and candidate permutations preserve corresponding scores; category routing selects the expected model. Padding transformations must preserve effective position IDs—arbitrary padding shifts need not preserve scores with positional embeddings. Inject disabled padding masks, count-minus-one readout, omitted inference masks, swapped routes and corrupted checkpoint parameters individually; measure which probes detect each fault. These are proposed adaptations, not published BERT4Rec detection results. [BERT4Rec implementation guidance](https://rectools.readthedocs.io/en/latest/examples/tutorials/transformers_tutorial.html).

Serving parity should compare the current model against its freshly loaded embedded predictor on identical histories/candidates, with evaluation mode enabled; report score errors and ranking agreement. PyTorch explicitly requires evaluation mode for consistent inference. Suggested reporting: detection rate among exercised non-equivalent mutants, false alarms on clean controls, completed/attempted probe availability, and per-probe runtime. Isolate optional dependency failures, retain completed measurements, mark unavailable probes explicitly, and regenerate gate reasons from current results. No measured rates are available from this search; keep these diagnostics separate from the fixed host evaluator. [PyTorch checkpoint guidance](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/beginner/basics/saveloadrun_tutorial.html).
